title: Waza: Small-N Wilson CI, Unbiased Pass^k, Seeded Bootstrap & Hake Gain
summary: Eval suites with 3-10 trials use Wilson score intervals (`WilsonCI`, bounded in [0, 1]), unbiased `PassHatK` (`C(successes, k) / C(trials, k)`), seeded 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap CIs (`BootstrapCIWithSeed`), and Hake's normalized gain `(post - pre) / (1 - pre)` to prevent small-sample coverage collapse and ceiling effects.

references.description: Seeded 10k-resample BootstrapCI, IsSignificant, and Hake NormalizedGain
